evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/g/a owns exactly four public int fields, two constructors (four-int and two-int), and two pair setters matching the classic low/high bounds record shape.

The AWT game shell rs/C.aZ() computes usable container width/height after subtracting frame insets and returns new rs/g/a(width,height); resize/rebuild logic then reads the record's high-dimension pair.

The class preserves the long-standing RuneScape Bounds fingerprint: low-coordinate setter, high-coordinate setter, two-arg convenience constructor using low=(0,0), and a toString() implementation returning null.

candidates.note: Recovered long-standing RuneScape Bounds identity from the exact class shape and game-shell consumer; not a canvas-specific invented name.
